registered_chat_goal: Act as the main responsible worker for AI-Statistician: take the hard central AgentRuntime and evaluation work, proactively coordinate other Codex/GitHub branches, preserve strict evidence boundaries, and keep driving the repo toward a live autonomous AI Statistical Theory Lab rather than side audits or easy patches.
current_goal_focus: Keep one thin outer research graph and durable model-owned Python, R, Theory, and Lean sessions; preserve exact source bytes and executable metric ABIs across every handoff; remove redundant phase behavior; and require cross-family kernel closure without task-specific fixes.
operating_principle: The model owns statistical, mathematical, Python, R, and Lean content. The harness owns execution, immutable identity, budgets, evaluation blindness, review separation, coarse evidence topology, and final authority; it does not author substantive fixes.
canonical_workspace_loop: the source-owning model reads the exact parent artifact and raw observation
the model chooses inspection, retrieval, a complete changed artifact, or an explicit typed gap
the local Python, R, simulation, or Lean environment executes the exact artifact unchanged
the raw observation returns to the same model until pass, explicit gap, or bounded exhaustion

forbidden: task-family answer, metric, Lean grammar, or tactic rules
routine Architect routing inside a source workspace
legacy task-family registries in the canonical runtime

changes: Theory workspace state is separated from retained transcript history, so tool turns do not recursively grow the mathematical artifact.
Direct model-owned workspace progress and exact source lineage are recorded without promoting diagnostics to proof or statistical acceptance.
Lean declaration inspection verifies the requested symbol and rejects an unrelated successful MCP response before indexed source fusion.
Architect feedback routing now uses a compact current-observation ACI instead of a long repeated policy essay and large history context.
The generic client-tool loop emits model-turn and tool-execution timing, including logical error, state-change, and terminal disposition metadata.

Source-ownership audit now checks explicit source-owner backedges, model-owned full-source rewrites, and exact consumer replay; ordinary statistical gate failures are not mislabeled as code-repair obligations.
Hash-bound confirmatory consumer failures return directly to the source-owning AlgorithmEngineer even after every required outer lane has been visited.
An independently accepted Simulation manifest remains visible in deferred Formalizer context, so a later formal gap cannot reopen and rerun the completed simulation lane.
Theory workspaces are explicitly told that failed scratch execution and unresolved errors have diagnostic, not empirical, authority.

Scientific, Lean, and source-grounded preflight client-tool loops request Anthropic prompt caching; a post-fix exact-Haiku live probe measured a full stable-prefix cache hit on the second Lean workspace turn.

The generic model-tool loop no longer supports rolling-history snapshots or caller-selected dynamic tool subsets. Scientific and Lean coding sessions keep one bounded linear transcript, while only the existing final-disposition recovery narrows to terminal tools.
Terminal-decision turns retain the stable provider tool schema for prompt caching while runtime execution rejects nonterminal actions after the standard budget.
Every model-facing tool observation includes only generic remaining turn/tool budget, so the same model can allocate its work without content-specific routing rules.
Scientific and Lean workspaces remember every previously executed source hash in the session and do not spend environment calls on A-to-B-to-A source cycles.
Simulation source workspaces now receive the complete frozen metric output ABI, and outcome-blind interface failures echo that exact ABI back to the same source owner.
Formalizer materialization preserves the exact model-authored Lean bytes instead of stripping trailing whitespace, so workspace, compiler, reviewer, and rejection hashes share one identity domain.
A locally compiling target fails closed when the independent exact-target reviewer is unavailable; Critic cannot substitute for that gate.
A kernel-promoted exact Lean source now reuses its hash-bound materialization and routes directly to Critic without another materialization, semantic review, or model rewrite.

Final Critic rechecks the linked LeanKernelPromotionResult, target IDs, authority labels, and Formalizer counts before accepting exact source-theorem closure; kernel-verified supporting subclaims alone cannot satisfy the target theorem gate.
AlgorithmEngineer cannot send a partial requested estimator set to independent review: every requested estimator artifact must pass its own model-owned execution workspace first.
Python and R source tools describe their language-specific scientific dependency sets directly to the coding model; runtime does not normalize or repair a mixed-language answer.

Final Critic prompts retain artifact IDs, status metadata, and content hashes while replacing complete theory, source, and simulation histories with references; the current observation remains explicit.

TheoryDeveloper now receives canonical output_contract and termination_guarantee fields, while independent preflight sees the complete bounded model-authored estimator record instead of a lossy field allowlist.

Outer-lane coverage now recognizes a completed workspace only under the current immutable parent artifacts; an Algorithm visit under an invalidated theory cannot cause Formalizer to overtake the revised theory's scientific rebuild.
Formalizer observation summaries aggregate every distinct workspace artifact rather than retaining only the final workspace per question and evidence type.

An evidence-bound Architect feedback-route decision is no longer replaced by initial lane-coverage scheduling; the model-selected owner resolves the active observation before independent unvisited lanes continue.

Confirmatory outcomes distinguish the current Simulation source from hash-bound upstream dependency identities. Dependency IDs become a revision scope only after the Architect model selects AlgorithmEngineer; runtime no longer labels every dependency as source-to-revise in advance.
No task answer, statistical threshold, Lean grammar rule, tactic rule, repair worker, or post-runtime scheduler was added.
